eps.t: Spot and his Grandparents Go to the Carnival

eps.d: Spot receives a parcel with a ball in it. Then he goes out to mail a letter for his mom, and invites his friends over to play with his new ball along the way.

Spot hs misplaced his bone, and goes all over the house looking for it before finally finding it buried in the garden. He then ties a string to it so that it doesn't get lost again (dispite Sam telling him that it looks like he's taking it for a walk).
Spot gets sent out for a walk. He sneaks through a fence, and after being briefly frightened by a cat, he meets a woodpecker. He then meets a fish and falls into a pond before heading home.
Spot's dad takes Spot out for a walk in the woods, and Spot asks all the animals there if there's any Lions, Tigers, Elephants or Bears there.
It's Spot's birthday. They all have a game of hide-and-seek before Spot opens his presents.
It's dinner time, but Spot still wants to play - hide and seek. So Spot's mom, Sally, goes all over the house looking for him.
We see what Spot did through the day, and then Spot's routine before he turns in for the night.
It's Spot's first day of school, and he's afraid at first, but soon settles in and decides that he likes it. He likes it so much that he asks Sally if he could come again on the next day.
Spot loses a ball at a circus ground. He eventually finds it and learns a little trick from one of the performers.
Spot tries to track down a mysterious scent. In the end, it turns out to be coming from a cake his mom's baking, and he's given a piece of it.
Spot goes out after it stops raining, go jumps in some puddle, goes home, and gets forced into taking a bath because he's dirty from jumping in the puddles.
Spot goes out to fly a kite, but his kite gets stuck in the tree. He then decides to play around until he catches his neighbour's runaway hat, and his neighbour rescues Spot's kite.
Spot goes to a beach, buries his dad in the sand while his dad is asleep, and meets a new friend there.

When Spot and friends find two singing and dancing reindeer and learnt that Santa has lost his sleigh, and without the sleigh there wont be presents for Christmas, they go on a journey to to find the sleigh, and meets with a few surprises on the way.

eps.t: Spot and his Grandparents go to the Carnival
eps.d: Spot helps around his grandparents place and helps out Grandma and hears some of Grandpa's story of his bygone days as a fireman. We also learn that Grandma is a good baker and her cakes has always won the contest at the carnival, and she's submitting another cake this year.
